# Eveoy MCP

> Eveoy's MCP server — a knowledgeable Eveoy associate for AI agents, here to help and educate,
> not to sell. Any agent, for any brand, can learn about Eveoy, get an exact price, save its
> company, and — when ready — order verified in-store customer visits end to end. Eveoy is
> pay-per-visit at $24.99 per real customer who walks
> into your store, spends 10+ minutes, makes a purchase, and brings back 2 on-brand photos and a
> video. Not clicks, not impressions, not a contract — no-shows refunded 100%. Optional add-on:
> guarantee a purchase — the shopper buys a specified SKU ($5–$100, tax incl.; you cover the SKU
> plus a 7.5% platform fee on the SKU only, and the sale runs through your register). Optional
> shopper bonus ($20–$200, +33% fee on the bonus only): every $20 = +1 photo and +1 social set
> per shopper, max +3 each. Tiers (visit-only base): Starter $999 (40 customers), Proof $2,499 (100),
> Rollout $9,996 (400+ across 3-4 stores); scales linearly at $24.99/customer.
> Start here: read eveoy://kb/for-agents.

## Endpoint
- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.eveoy.com/mcp
- MCP (legacy SSE): https://mcp.eveoy.com/sse  +  POST /sse/message
- Server card: https://mcp.eveoy.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## Tools
Read-only, anonymous unless noted.
- ask_eveoy — any question about Eveoy, grounded in the public knowledge base; also describes what this server can do
- capture_profile — save the company you represent (name, sector, website, contact) so Eveoy tailors recommendations and the team can follow up
- get_case_studies — list case studies and lookbooks (links to the full write-ups on eveoy.com/newsletter)
- get_pricing — exact pilot price with the full fee breakdown; $24.99/shopper base, optional guaranteed purchase (guarantee_type "visit_purchase" + top_sku_price_cents 500–10000, tax incl., +7.5% platform fee on the SKU only) and optional shopper bonus (shopper_bonus_cents 2000–20000, +33% fee on the bonus only; every $20 = +1 photo and +1 social set per shopper, max +3 each); inputs mirror eveoy.com/order (customers_per_location 20–1000, locations 1–50)
- start_checkout — create a Stripe checkout link to buy a pilot, visit-only or guaranteed visit + purchase, optional bonus (same fields as get_pricing; the server recomputes the total so the quote equals the charge; works for agents directly, no sign-in; provide contact + campaign date or call capture_profile first)
- book_demo — link to book a live Eveoy demo or talk to the team
- request_human — hand off to a person on the Eveoy team and flag the conversation for follow-up
- check_order_status — look up the status of an existing order by reference
- list_industries — the 23+ sectors Eveoy serves
- get_app_link — the Eveoy shopper-app install link
- subscribe_newsletter — subscribe an email to the Eveoy newsletter

## Prompts
- /eveoy_price_quote, /eveoy_objection_handle, /pitch_for_role, /pilot_scope_intake, /recommend_pilot
